The '''Ksiczzic system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ksiczzic III]].
